updateProduct_9454a9af90.description:
Successfully compiled but failed at runtime.

Error Analysis:
* What Failed: Mockito WrongTypeOfReturnValue – getPrice() was stubbed to return null, but its signature returns primitive double
* Where: ProductControllerUpdateProductTest.updateProductAllowsNullFields (line 80)
* Why: Test simulates nullable fields by returning null for a primitive; also reports unnecessary stubs (lines 77–79)
* Investigate: If price can be null, change to Double in DTO/model; otherwise stub a valid double (e.g., 0.0) or remove the stub. If spying, use doReturn(...). Clean up unused stubbings or mark lenient.,
